name: RIYA BHATIA
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A gritty player with a strong backhand and adaptability across surfaces, peaking on hard courts.
Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #338 (March 2, 2020), Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #331 (December 23, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 3 ITF singles titles (2017 Egypt W15, 2019 Sri Lanka W15, 2020 Solapur W15) and 4 doubles titles. WTA Debut: Lost R1 at 2021 Bad Homburg Open to Laura Siegemund. Billie Jean King Cup: 4-6 record for India (2017-2022). Asian Games: Competed in 2018 Palembang (R2). National Titles: Won 2016 hardcourt and grass-court Nationals.
Other Highlights: Formerly India’s No. 2 woman (2020). Reduced activity since 2022 due to injuries. Aims to regain Top 400 form.
Riya’s early promise has been tempered by challenges, but her experience remains vital. 🎾🇮🇳
